cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unlock the costume cupboard. I taught you to spot moth damage; I'm here to check your work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That inspector badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent eye for materials. Now use it on the velvet; how many holes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get the wardrobe manager. She'll ask who authorized this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as someone helping with the moths. Keep it relevant, like I taught you. Show her the velvet before you start discussing my stationery.

reason: Make actual pupil correction direct the exact pursuit; preserve cause and effect, explicitly stating any necessary practical distinction.
